onb.day3_setup_body:
Hello {name},

To start taking patients on {brand}:
- Add your doctors and their working hours.
- Add your services and prices.
- Add your team (reception, nurses) with their roles.

It takes about ten minutes. If you need help, just reply to this e-mail.
onb.day7_booking_body:
Hello {name},

Your clinic has its own booking page: share it on WhatsApp, Instagram and Google so patients book themselves, and they get reminders before their visit.

Turn it on from Settings → Online booking.
